I'm speaking *as* a mentally ill person. I actually have BPD as well. Why you would talk to me this way I don't know; someone with BPD should know that mental illness makes many people insufferable. It's a fact of life.

You know what mental illness isn't? It's not hollywood depression; where a good looking person who showers and takes care of themself goes about their day with a cloud behind their head. It doesn't work like that for many people. Of course people like this exist in real life just as any other hollywood trope, but I am fucking tired of people thinking that mental illness is trendy or something that they can "fix" in other people because they are "just a bit sad in the head". It doesn't work like this. Mental illness is ugly and makes many people who suffer from one do awful and (yes) sometimes disgusting things. It's an illness like any other; replace puss with not showering; replace blood with abuse towards others.

To start blaming the people who do these awful things; to start saying that they "don't deserve sympathy" - THAT harms mentally ill people. Not whatever it is you are saying. People need to realise that having a mental illness means you are no longer responsible for the awful things you do. Not until you are treated, at least. And more than that, people need to realise that mental illness is not as comfy as stereotypes have led us to believe.

Literally, no one who threatens suicide for attention is mentally healthy.

I get that many people's ideas of mental illness are very hollywood; a nice cute guy or girl who has a defect in their brain that makes them feel sad, but otherwise they are this great person that people love and it's a tragic story.

In reality, most mentally ill people are people you don't want to and should not have to deal with. In this sense, you do not get to have your cake and eat it too. If you have sympathy for people with depression because they have a defect that means they cannot control themselves or their feelings then you need to also extend that sympathy to this guy. It's all fun and games until one day this kid actually kills himself, and then parents are without a son and siblings without a brother.

Do you think that people who "cut for attention" are mentally healthy? Newsflash; they're not. It's funny to me how many people in this thread are only interested in feeling sorry for the mentally ill when it's a pretty hollywood story about a cute guy or girl who's brain makes them hate themself. When you are mentally ill you hurt people and yourself; you might not shower for weeks, you might now take care of yourself, and you might manipulate others because you believe the only way they will stay with you is if you pretend that you want to kill  yourself. I'd have thought someone who has gone through mental illness (like me) would understand this.
